name: Madumareans
description:
An obscure, isolated cult of the sea-goddess Madumare founded around a sacrificial wave-altar built from giant mineralized bones, the Madumareans were once of such great numbers that their ships carried the faith to every corner of the land.

But there was trouble at home: a mysterious orange goo began to seep out of the ground, corrupting the villages and grasslands around the temple, fouling the shores, and scattering the great majority of the faithful to the four winds. While some remain, working to cleanse the region and discover the reasons for their goddess' abandonment of them, most Madumareans have become nomadic, traveling in sad, tired bands, offering their sacrifices to lesser watercourses of lesser divinity.

Meanwhile, forgotten on his remote island, Elder Brother continues his undying solitude…

hooks.name: Straight to the Source
hooks.description: The orange goo is creeping closer and closer to the Wave Temple, despite the acolytes' best efforts. Now a group of the faithful is going to attempt to trace the orange goo back to its origin, which is suspected to be deep within the island's calcified caverns.
hooks.gmNotes:
The caverns should be a complex network of passages and chambers, which fill and empty without warning as the goo moves through them.

In a central chamber, Our Heroes should discover that the goo is actually the weeping, infected blood of a trapped primordial entity, directly beneath the Wave Temple. Was it drawn to this place by the power of the Madumareans' sacrifices, or was the Temple built to hold it at bay? Or is the being... "Madumare" herself?

hooks.name: The Goddess' New Form
hooks.description: A desperate village near the Temple has begun consuming marine life mutated by the orange sludge to avoid starvation. The villagers are rapidly transforming into amphibious, hive-minded zealots who seek to drag outsiders into the fouled surf to "receive the Goddess’s new form."
hooks.gmNotes:
The villagers are indeed crazed, but there seems to be some truth to their message, as those who disappear beneath the waves emerge unharmed and even more adamant that others should join them.

Should Our Heroes ingest any of the corrupted fish, it should of course be gross, but they should also receive a vision or a brief mental interaction with a kind-seeming entity that is in evident distress and is in need of urgent help. They should also find that they are able to breathe underwater for a period after eating it.

Beneath the waves, they should find Madumare herself - whatever you decide she is - trapped by a parasitic force that has nearly consumed her.

hooks.name: The Awakening Bones
hooks.description: As the orange goo has spread into the Bone Fields, villagers report that the bones appear to be moving: a femur in a valley one day is found on the hillside next morning, a skull facing North at noon faces East at nightfall. These movements appear to be becoming increasingly common, and locals are becoming worried.
hooks.gmNotes:
An investigation of reported incidents should reveal that the movement of the bones is not random: groups of them appear to be moving toward each other, centered on a point in one of the villages.

As these bones converge, at first, whole skeletons of normal-sized beasts should reassemble and become aggressive, then skeletons of increasing size and ferocity, until we reach epic proportions.

Should our heroes manage to impede the movements of some of the bones, consider strange assemblages: a massive quadruped with the head of a shark-like creature, etc.

Also, given that the locals have long made use of the great bones as building materials, whole dwellings should suddenly shift and reassemble themselves into unexpected threats.

The cause of all this? What's pulling these bones toward the village? A tomb hidden in the center of town contains the bones of a humanoid who was once a shepherd of these great beasts. If they can be reassembled, they will lead away the fearsome creatures.
